title: 29 South Monroe Avenue (House), Columbus, Franklin County, OH
notes: Significance: The building contributes to the Columbus Near East Side Historic District, a predominately residential area containing those architectural styles favored by the upper middle class from the 1880s to the 1930s. This building is typical of the houses built between 1900 and 1920.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 78002063
